prompt:
StarRocks REFRESH MATERIALIZED VIEW raises ParseError when it has its optional clauses: PARTITION START (...) END (...), FORCE, and WITH SYNC MODE / WITH ASYNC MODE. These should parse into exp.Refresh and round-trip in StarRocks; incomplete mode clauses (WITH, MODE, WITH SYNC, WITH ASYNC) must still raise ParseError; and generating these options for dialects that do not support them (the default dialect, Postgres) must report them as unsupported.

For example:

```python
from sqlglot import parse_one, transpile, exp

parse_one("REFRESH MATERIALIZED VIEW db.lo_mv1 PARTITION START ('2020-02-01') END ('2020-03-01') FORCE WITH SYNC MODE", read="starrocks").sql("starrocks")
# currently: ParseError: Expecting (. Line 1, Col: 51.
# expected:  REFRESH MATERIALIZED VIEW db.lo_mv1 PARTITION START ('2020-02-01') END ('2020-03-01') FORCE WITH SYNC MODE

parse_one('REFRESH MATERIALIZED VIEW lo_mv1 PARTITION START ("2020-02-01") END ("2020-03-01")', read="starrocks").sql("starrocks")
# currently: ParseError: Expecting (. Line 1, Col: 48.
# expected:  REFRESH MATERIALIZED VIEW lo_mv1 PARTITION START ('2020-02-01') END ('2020-03-01')

parse_one("REFRESH MATERIALIZED VIEW mv WITH ASYNC MODE", read="starrocks").sql("starrocks")
# currently: ParseError: Invalid expression / Unexpected token. Line 1, Col: 33.
# expected:  REFRESH MATERIALIZED VIEW mv WITH ASYNC MODE
```

Other forms of the same constructs described above should work as well.

prompt_original:
feat(starrocks): support REFRESH MATERIALIZED VIEW options [CLAUDE] (#8613)

Parses the optional PARTITION START (...) END (...), FORCE and
WITH { SYNC | ASYNC } MODE clauses, which previously raised a ParseError.
